description.narrative: EU-UNDP Good governance anti-corruption project 2025 - 2027. Supporting the ACC to enhance and coordinate implementation of NACSAP

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

title.narrative: Compliance Rate: Percentage of key performance indicators (KPIs) from the NACSAP that the ACC has successfully met by 2028, indicating the level of achievement towards the plan's objectives.

description.narrative: Status of the stakeholder engagement plan that outlines the roles and responsibilities and the mechanisms participation in the NACSAP implementation: This indicator measures the compliance rate, expressed as the percentage of key performance indicators (KPIs) outlined in the National Anti-Corruption Strategy and Action Plan (NACSAP) that the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has successfully achieved by 2028. It reflects the ACC's progress in implementing the strategic objectives and action points identified in the NACSAP to combat corruption and promote good governance. The compliance rate serves as a metric for evaluating the effectiveness, efficiency, and impact of the ACC's interventions. A higher percentage indicates stronger alignment with the NACSAP's goals and demonstrates tangible progress in addressing corruption, enhancing institutional accountability, and fostering public trust.

title.narrative: Percentage increase in joint anti-corruption initiatives or operations between the ACC and relevant institutions from 2024 to 2028.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage increase in joint anti-corruption initiatives or operations conducted by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) in collaboration with relevant institutions between 2024 and 2028. Joint initiatives or operations include coordinated investigations, public awareness campaigns, capacity-building programs, and policy development efforts aimed at preventing and combating corruption. The indicator reflects the growth in cooperative actions, highlighting the strengthening of partnerships and the ACC's commitment to a multi-stakeholder approach to addressing corruption. An increase in this percentage demonstrates enhanced collaboration, resource sharing, and collective impact, contributing to more effective anti-corruption outcomes and fostering a culture of accountability and integrity across sectors.

title.narrative: Percentage increase of the monitoring and evaluation of the Whistleblower Protection Act, 10 of 2017 and Witness Protection Act, 11 of 2017 implemented and monitored.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage increase in the effectiveness and scope of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) activities related to the implementation of the Whistleblower Protection Act, No. 10 of 2017, and the Witness Protection Act, No. 11 of 2017. It tracks improvements in the mechanisms, processes, and practices used to assess compliance with the Acts, gauge their impact, and ensure their provisions are effectively protecting whistleblowers and witnesses. The indicator also reflects the progressive strengthening of institutional capacity, data collection, reporting, and feedback loops essential for enhancing the accountability, transparency, and functionality of these legislative frameworks. It serves as a benchmark for evaluating progress in safeguarding individuals who expose wrongdoing or serve as witnesses, thus promoting a culture of justice and integrity.

title.narrative: Number of training capacity building interventions developed and conducted for oversight bodies from 2024 to 2028, and the percentage of oversight body staff who have participated in these programs

description.narrative: This indicator measures the total number of capacity-building interventions developed and conducted for oversight bodies from 2024 to 2028, as well as the percentage of staff from these bodies who have actively participated in the programs. Capacity-building interventions include workshops, seminars, technical training, and other skill-enhancement activities designed to strengthen the knowledge, skills, and competencies of oversight body personnel. These programs aim to enhance institutional effectiveness in promoting transparency, accountability, and good governance. The percentage of staff participation provides an additional dimension to assess the reach and inclusiveness of these interventions. Together, these metrics reflect progress in equipping oversight bodies with the necessary tools and expertise to fulfill their mandates effectively.

title.narrative: Number of public institutions that have a code of conduct/integrity plan and monitor its implementation

description.narrative:
This indicator measures the total number of public institutions that have developed and adopted a code of conduct or integrity plan and actively monitor its implementation. It reflects the commitment of these institutions to promote ethical behavior, transparency, and accountability in their operations.
The indicator encompasses the establishment of clear guidelines and standards for professional conduct, mechanisms for monitoring adherence to these standards, and actions taken to address non-compliance. It serves as a benchmark for assessing progress in institutionalizing integrity frameworks across the public sector, contributing to a culture of good governance and public trust.

title.narrative: Efficient monitoring and evaluation systems in place and operational

description.narrative: The indicator measures the existence of a well-established and functional framework for tracking the progress, performance, and outcomes of projects, programs, or policies. This indicator measures whether there are comprehensive, transparent, and systematic mechanisms in place to monitor activities and assess their effectiveness. An operational M&E system typically includes clear guidelines for data collection, analysis, and reporting, as well as mechanisms for feedback and adaptation. It ensures that decision-makers have accurate, timely, and relevant information to inform strategic planning and improve the efficiency and impact of interventions. Key features of an efficient M&E system include a skilled M&E team, appropriate tools and resources, regular performance reviews, and the ability to use findings for continuous improvement.

title.narrative: Number of citizens awareness campaigns to combat corruption.

description.narrative:
This indicator tracks the number of awareness campaigns conducted to educate and engage citizens in the fight against corruption. These campaigns aim to inform the public about the forms, consequences, and reporting mechanisms for corrupt practices, while promoting a culture of integrity and accountability.
The campaigns may include a variety of outreach methods such as workshops, public forums, media broadcasts, social media initiatives, and community engagements. This indicator reflects the efforts to empower citizens with knowledge and tools to recognize and resist corruption, fostering active participation in promoting transparency and good governance.

title.narrative: Number of audited/reviewed government activities and expenditures (2024-2028) and implementation rate of corrective actions/recommendations

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of government activities and expenditures audited or reviewed from 2024 to 2028 and the implementation rate of corrective actions and recommendations arising from these audits and reviews. The first component reflects the scope and frequency of financial and operational oversight conducted to ensure transparency, accountability, and compliance with established regulations. The second component evaluates the extent to which corrective measures and recommendations from these audits are effectively implemented, serving as a measure of the government's commitment to addressing identified gaps and improving governance. Together, these metrics provide a comprehensive assessment of the robustness of the audit processes and the effectiveness of follow-up actions, contributing to better public sector management and enhanced trust in government operations.

title.narrative: Number of agreements/commitments for effective partnership signed between the ACC and relevant institutions engaged in anti-corruption efforts

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of agreements or commitments formalized between the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) and relevant institutions actively engaged in anti-corruption efforts. These agreements may take the form of memoranda of understanding (MoUs), partnership frameworks, or other collaborative arrangements aimed at fostering coordinated and effective anti-corruption strategies. The indicator reflects the ACC's efforts to build and strengthen strategic alliances with governmental bodies, civil society organizations, international agencies, and other stakeholders. These partnerships are essential for pooling resources, sharing expertise, and enhancing the collective impact of anti-corruption initiatives. A higher number of agreements indicates progress in creating a united front against corruption, promoting accountability, and leveraging multi-sectoral cooperation to achieve shared goals..

title.narrative: Stakeholder Perception: Reduction in citizen perception of the ACC's commitment to fighting corruption and promoting accountability and transparency in various sectors of society, providing qualitative insights into the impact and effectiveness of the ACC's efforts

description.narrative: This indicator assesses the change in stakeholder perceptions, specifically focusing on a reduction in citizen confidence regarding the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC)'s commitment to fighting corruption and promoting accountability and transparency across various sectors of society. The indicator provides qualitative insights into the public’s views on the ACC’s effectiveness, credibility, and impact. It is measured through surveys, focus groups, and other participatory methods to gauge shifts in attitudes and trust levels over time. A decline in positive perceptions signals a potential gap in the ACC's strategies, communication, or outcomes, underscoring areas where improvements in performance, public engagement, or transparency might be needed to rebuild public confidence and reinforce the ACC's role in combating corruption.

title.narrative: Technical assistance to ACC availed through dedicated anti-corruption expertise

description.narrative: Indicator measures the provision of specialized support and guidance to the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) by experts in the field of anti-corruption through EU Funded support. This indicator measures the availability and deployment of dedicated technical resources, including advisors, consultants, or capacity-building initiatives, to enhance the ACC's effectiveness in preventing, investigating, and prosecuting corruption. The technical assistance may involve providing expert knowledge in areas such as legal frameworks, investigative techniques, governance practices, or policy development. It ensures that the ACC is equipped with the necessary skills, tools, and resources to strengthen its operations, improve its capacity to address corruption, and support the implementation of anti-corruption strategies.

title.narrative: Number of staff capacitated across ACC/GRN (technical staff) supporting implementation of NACSAP

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of technical staff from the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) and the Government of the Republic of Namibia (GRN) who have been trained and capacitated to support the implementation of the National Anti-Corruption Strategy and Action Plan (NACSAP). Capacity-building efforts may include specialized training programs, workshops, technical assistance, and knowledge-sharing initiatives aimed at enhancing the skills and expertise required to effectively implement NACSAP objectives. This indicator reflects the commitment to strengthening institutional and human resource capabilities, ensuring that staff are equipped to execute anti-corruption strategies, monitor progress, and address challenges efficiently. An increase in the number of capacitated staff demonstrates progress in building a robust and skilled workforce dedicated to achieving NACSAP's goals.
